page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The instance features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory allocation stands at 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The processor includes 33 MB of L3 cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 KB of L1 data cache, with support for instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512F, and AES. There is no bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and network throughput provides a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reflects typical characteristics of an older compute-focused architecture. Single-thread processing registers in lower tiers, indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 960.0 and single-threaded gzip compression performance of 19.02 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded metrics perform within median distributions, highlighted by a multi-core Geekbench score of 8426.0, a PassMark CPU score of 22982.48, and stress-ng multi-core throughput of 23557.71. Memory throughput shows uncached read performance of 74.54 GB/sec and write performance of 34.35 GB/sec, while cached small-block reads achieve 1313.24 GB/sec.

Resource allocation presents clear tradeoffs. The 1:2 compute profile provides substantial concurrent CPU density, which benefits parallel computational tasks such as clang compilation (18724.0 in Geekbench) and ray tracing (19799.0). However, the lower single-core throughput and modest 2.0 GB per core memory allocation constrain operations demanding heavy single-thread execution speed, extensive in-memory processing, or significant local disk input/output. Operationally, the instance relies entirely on network-attached storage due to the absence of integrated local storage volumes.

The ecs.sn1.7xlarge is suitable for parallel batch computing, continuous integration builds, multi-threaded encoding, and distributed worker nodes where computational tasks can be partitioned across 32 threads without requiring massive per-thread memory.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.7xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores, 64.0 GB of RAM (a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio), and 6 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. The instance includes no local storage volumes and no discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarks highlight solid median multi-threaded performance, with a PassMark CPU score of 22982.48 and Geekbench multi-core score of 8426.0, contrasted with weaker single-core processing capabilities such as a 960.0 single-core Geekbench score. Memory bandwidth reaches 74.54 GB/sec on uncached reads. Due to its balanced multi-core density and compute emphasis, this server fits distributed compilation, batch processing, CI/CD workloads, and multi-threaded background workers.
